newsitem.title: USA: CDI sees Q1 approximating Q4.
newsitem.headline: CDI sees Q1 approximating Q4.

text.p: CDI Corp, reporting 1996 fourth quarter earnings from continuing operations of $0.52 a share, said Thursday it expected about the same results for the 1997 first quarter.

In the year-ago first quarter it earned $0.44 per share from continuing operations, excluding a loss of $0.01 from discontinued auto developmental engineering and auto manufacturing technology operations.

The discontinued operations incurred fourth quarter operating losses in 1996 and 1995 as well as losses anticipated upon sale or termination of the discontinued businesses and estimated losses from operations of the discontinued businesses until termination or sale.

The disposition of these businesses is expected to occur by mid-1997, CDI said. The retained staffing operations serving automotive customers will be integrated into CDI's national staffing organization.
After taking into account fourth quarter losses from discontinued operations, CDI's net earnings for the quarter were $0.16 a share, compared year-earlier loss of $0.65.

After a traditional seasonal pause in the fourth quarter and into the first quarter, CDI said, it is now seeing a resumption of growth, driven mainly by strong demand for information technology staffing and services.

In addition to the seasonal fluctuations, the results in the fourth quarter and into the first quarter are affected by a flattening in chemicals/petro-chemicals demand and a decline in telecommunications, it said. These softenings are expected to be offset by continued growth in information technology, it said.

CDI is broadening its information technology base and breaking into the insurance, financial, banking, healthcare, energy and pharmaceutical markets. During 1996 it achieved information technology revenues of over $200 million. Thus far, all of this business has been generated internally and without acquisitions.
